derivation: probably from H1856 (דָּקַר) with a prepositional prefix; by stabbing, i.e. assassin;

occurrences.text: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the Lord laid this burden upon him;
